abstract.text: A Swift SDK for discovering and interacting with Last Lock devices over Bluetooth.

inlineContent.text: LinkMobile connects your app to Last Lock hardware with a simple, high-level API. It handles Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) discovery, connection, and proxy-backed communication so you can focus on your product experience instead of writing a BLE stack.
The SDK also supports a background proxy connection that lets devices communicate with Last Lock’s cloud services when required.
